text: {"label":"Learning Models, Generalization, and Decision Making","definition":"Theoretical and quantitative accounts of learning, including associative and timing models, generalization across stimulus dimensions, model selection methods, and decision making with graphed or time-series data.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on formal learning and decision models and quantitative analysis, rather than equivalence class formation, operant variability and response units, or evolutionary theory of behavior dynamics."}
